title: kate-ui: go to the definition and list the references
summary: f12 and cmd-click request the definition at the caret and open the first location in a tab with the caret at its start. shift-f12 requests the references and lists them in the bottom pane; a click opens that location. Locations in files outside the open set open new documents.

lane.reason: A Cursor local agent on the owner Mac codes this packet. session.rs imports GPUI, the crate builds only on macOS, and the owner looks at the window after the change.

definitions.definition:
/// Open `path` if needed and move the caret of its view to line and character.
fn open_at(&mut self, path: &std::path::Path, line: u32, character: u32, window: &mut Window, cx: &mut Context<Self>)

data_contracts.schema_diff_summary: GoToDefinition sends definition_params for the caret and remembers the request id; when its Response arrives, locations and location_target give the first target and open_at opens it. FindReferences does the same with references_params and lists every target in the bottom pane as path:line. open_at sends FileRequest::OpenPath when the document is not open, then Command::MoveTo with one caret at from_lsp of the position. Bind f12 and shift-f12 and add both to the Go menu. The test open_at_moves_the_caret opens a temp file with two lines in a window root test workspace and asserts the view caret is at the start of line 1 after open_at(path, 1, 0). The owner presses f12 on a symbol with a server running. Do not nest an if inside an if. When two arms return the same value, write one condition with ||. Add each new test at the end of the one test module of the file, before its closing brace; create that module when the file is new. Do not write a second mod tests. An item with no caller outside tests gets #[cfg_attr(not(test), allow(dead_code))]; the packet that adds the caller removes it. Branch from the current tip of main. base_sha records that tip at planning time. If main has moved, use the new tip.

regression_tests.name: session::tests::open_at_moves_the_caret
regression_tests.asserts: This test fails on main because open_at does not exist. After the change the file opens and the caret sits at the requested line.
